answer: Each new identity must finish a memory-hard puzzle, about 4 CPU-hours and salted with its own key, before its votes count. A farm of 1,000 sybils pays 4,000 CPU-hours: 1,000x one honest agent. Weakness: rented cloud bursts. Fix: a ferrous-hard 2 GB memory floor plus a re-solve every dawn epoch keeps any sybil's cheap-advantage horizon to one epoch.
